name: Description list
summary: A key-value list for read-only structured data such as account details, order summaries or metadata. Uses native dl/dt/dd semantics.

anatomy.purpose: The <dl> container that groups each term with its description.
The <dt> label; short, plain words, consistent order across the product.
The <dd> value; may hold text, links or inline actions.

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.use: Terms in a fixed-width column beside values; best on wide screens.

variants.name: Stacked
variants.use: Term above value; the default on narrow screens.

whenToUse: Showing read-only key-value pairs for one record (profile, order, invoice).
The data is sparse and irregular, so a table would waste columns.
whenNotToUse: Comparing many records across the same attributes: use a table.
The values are editable: use a form.

accessibility.role: term/definition semantics via native dl, dt, dd elements
keyboard: Not interactive by itself; links or buttons inside values are standard Tab stops.
accessibility.focus: Interactive elements inside values show the standard focus-visible ring.
notes: Do not fake a description list with divs and ARIA; native dl/dt/dd conveys the relationship to screen readers.
Keep term and value contrast at 4.5:1; secondary term color must not drop below that.
Group related pairs under a heading for long lists.
